title: Tagine-Style Algerian Stew with Tofu and Acrid
description: A flavorful and nutritious gluten-free stew inspired by Algerian cuisine, made with tofu, acrid, and tagine spices.
instructions: 1. Heat the olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
2. Add the chopped onion and sauté until softened, about 5 minutes.
3. Add the minced garlic and cook for another minute.
4. Add the cubed tofu and cook until golden brown, about 5 minutes.
5. Add the chopped acrid, tagine spice mix, chickpeas, diced tomatoes, and salt. Stir well.
6. Bring the mixture to a simmer and let cook for 20-25 minutes, or until the flavors have melded together and the tofu is cooked through.
7. Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
8. Garnish with chopped fresh parsley and serve over gluten-free couscous or rice.
